name: KillingFloor
description: This Docker will download and install SteamCMD. It will also install Killing Floor and run it. To run this container you must provide a valid Steam username and password since the game needs a valid account to download (NOTICE: You must disable Steam Guard otherwise this container will not work, Steam recommens to make a new Steam account for dedicated servers). ATTENTION: First Startup can take very long since it downloads the gameserver files! Update Notice: Simply restart the container if a newer version of the game is available. You can also run multiple servers with only one SteamCMD directory!

variables.name: GAME_ID
variables.description: The GAME_ID that the container download at startup. (https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List)

variables.name: GAME_PARAMS
variables.description: Type in your Extra Game Parameters seperated with - (like: KF-bioticslab.rom?game=KFmod.KFGameType?VACSecured=true?MaxPlayers=6 -DisableDeathSpectator)

variables.name: Steam-Username
variables.description: Your Steam username goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).

variables.name: Validate Installation
variables.description: Set the Variable to 'true' if you want to validate the installation otherwise leave it blank.

variables.name: Steam-Password
variables.description: Your Steam password goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).
